Work from the same lab showed that mice treated with testosterone propionate for 14 days elicited a 77% increase in muscle hypertrophy and a 66% increase in myonuclei count (59). Muscle fiber size returned to baseline levels 3 weeks after discontinuation of steroid administration. However, the myonuclei count remained elevated for at least 3 months, which amounts to over 10% of the animal's life span.
